markets.name: Cadott Farmer's Market
markets.about: The Cadott Farmers Market is dedicated to supporting small family farms, producers and artisans. We strive to bring diverse offerings to the Market to ensure local, fresh, nutritious foods and artisanal products are available to our community and shoppers weekly.
